style.vernacular: Sprawling equatorial megacity: cream, white and pastel painted-render houses and ruko shophouses of 2-4 storeys with terracotta or grey metal pitched roofs and walled yards; dense kampung neighbourhoods of tin and tile; glass and concrete towers along Sudirman and Thamrin; white-washed Dutch colonial buildings with green shutters in Kota Tua and Menteng; 1950s-60s Sukarno-era modernist monuments and mosques; Javanese joglo-style stepped roofs on government and airport buildings.
style.ornament: Javanese joglo/limasan stepped tiled roofs and open pendopo halls on civic and airport buildings; Dutch colonial white walls with green louvred shutters, tall arched doors and cupolas; Chinese red-and-gold temples with upswept eaves in Glodok and Ancol; Sukarno-era monuments with bold geometric forms; kala-makara and batik-pattern relief panels.

sources.what: Dutch colonial masonry Batavia, Indies Style with joglo/limasan roofs, 1950s jengki style, International Style, steep roofs and deep eaves for rain
